docs.title: Rò rỉ dữ liệu
docs.text: Incident report #A-17. At 02:14 the monitoring system detected that a misconfigured storage bucket had been publicly readable for 36 hours. It contained exported customer records including names, emails and partial card numbers. Access logs show downloads from three unknown IP addresses. The bucket has now been locked, but the data may already be circulating.

docs.title: Máy in hỏng
docs.text: Ticket #B-203. The shared printer on the third floor jams every few pages since Monday. Staff can still print on the second floor. No data or security impact. The vendor can replace the roller during the next scheduled visit.

docs.title: Đăng nhập lạ
docs.text: Alert #C-58. A staff account logged in from a new country at 23:40, then changed its recovery email. The user says it was not them. No files were downloaded and the session was revoked after 12 minutes. Password reset is pending.
